steps.instruction: Turn on the TV. Connect your phone to the same home Wi-Fi.

steps.title: Choose Samsung

steps.note: Use your real device. This picture is an illustration.

steps.title: Open Samsung TV setup

steps.note: Use your real device. This picture is an illustration.

steps.title: Begin setup
steps.instruction: Tap Start.
steps.note: Use your real device. This picture is an illustration.

steps.title: Choose the room
steps.instruction: Choose the TV’s room and continue.
steps.note: Use your real device. This picture is an illustration.

steps.title: Select your actual TV
steps.instruction: Choose the TV that matches the one in front of you.
steps.note: If several TVs look alike, stop and confirm the device before approval.

steps.title: Approve on the television
steps.instruction: Read the request on your TV. Select OK only for the phone you are pairing.
steps.note: No request appeared? Do not assume approval. Check the official guide.

steps.title: Finish in SmartThings
steps.instruction: Give the TV a recognizable name, then tap Done.

steps.title: Check the actual result

routes.title: LG — pair with ThinQ
routes.applies_to: Supported LG TVs, generally 2017 or later; some models are excluded. This is a menu-family guide, not a guarantee for every LG model.

steps.title: Use the same home network
steps.instruction: Turn on the TV. Connect your phone to the same home Wi-Fi.
steps.note: A network name or IP address alone does not identify or authorize a TV.

steps.title: Install LG ThinQ
steps.instruction: Open your phone’s app store. Find the official LG ThinQ app and install it. If already installed, continue.
steps.note: Check that this is the official app from the TV or app maker. Use your real phone for any download or account approval.

steps.title: Use the official account screen
steps.instruction: Sign in inside LG ThinQ. Review the account name before continuing.
steps.note: Enter passwords only in the official app or its sign-in page, never in this guide.

steps.title: Add your television
steps.instruction: In ThinQ, tap Add a Device.
steps.note: Use your real device. This picture is an illustration.

steps.title: Open the device selector
steps.instruction: Tap Select Device.
steps.note: Use your real device. This picture is an illustration.

steps.title: Confirm the same network
steps.instruction: Check that the TV is on and your phone uses the same Wi-Fi. Then tap Next.
steps.note: LG places this confirmation after Select Device and before the TV list. Follow the screen in your actual ThinQ version.

steps.title: Choose your LG TV
steps.instruction: Select the TV you intend to pair from the discovered devices.
steps.note: Use your real device. This picture is an illustration.

steps.title: Read the TV code
steps.instruction: Keep the TV PIN visible.
steps.note: Use your real device. This picture is an illustration.

steps.title: Enter the real PIN
steps.instruction: Type the PIN displayed on your own TV into ThinQ.
steps.note: Never use the placeholder dots as a code.

steps.title: Confirm the entered PIN
steps.instruction: After entering the TV PIN, tap Next in ThinQ.
steps.note: If the TV rejects the code, keep the same TV selected and follow the official pairing help.

steps.title: Decide whether to link accounts
steps.instruction: Choose Link only if you also want your ThinQ devices on the TV Home Board; otherwise choose Skip.
steps.note: The Link highlight is an example, not a recommendation. Choose Skip if you do not want this optional account link.

steps.title: Finish registration
steps.instruction: Select Go to Home in ThinQ.
steps.note: Use your real device. This picture is an illustration.

steps.title: Check the actual result
steps.instruction: Look in LG ThinQ for your TV. If it is missing, use “My screen looks different”.
steps.note: Finishing this guide does not connect Audio Bodyguard or activate protection.
